title: Factory Method Pattern
description: Create objects without specifying the exact class
explanation: Factory pattern encapsulates object creation, allowing the client to create objects without knowing concrete types.

title: Observer Pattern
description: Notify multiple observers when state changes
explanation: Observer pattern establishes a one-to-many dependency so that when one object changes state, all dependents are notified.

title: Strategy Pattern
description: Define a family of algorithms, encapsulate each one, and make them interchangeable
explanation: Strategy pattern lets you select an algorithm at runtime by encapsulating it behind a common interface.

title: Builder Pattern
description: Construct complex objects step by step with a fluent interface
explanation: Builder pattern separates the construction of a complex object from its representation.

title: Sparse Table
description: O(1) range queries (min, max, gcd) on static arrays after O(n log n) preprocessing
explanation: Sparse table enables O(1) range minimum/maximum queries by precomputing power-of-two intervals.

title: Mo's Algorithm
description: Efficiently answer offline range queries by reordering them
explanation: Mo's algorithm sorts offline range queries to minimize pointer movement, achieving O((N+Q)√N) complexity.

title: Heavy Light Decomposition
description: Decompose tree into chains for path queries
explanation: HLD splits a tree into heavy and light paths, enabling path queries in O(log² n) using segment tree.

title: Matrix Exponentiation
description: Solve linear recurrences in O(k³ log n) using matrix exponentiation
explanation: Matrix exponentiation computes nth term of linear recurrences in O(k³ log n) using fast exponentiation.

title: Policy Based Data Structures (PBDS)
description: GCC extension: ordered set with order statistics in O(log n)
explanation: PBDS ordered_set extends std::set with order_of_key (O(log n)) and find_by_order (O(log n)).

title: Std Format (C++20)
explanation: std::format provides Python-like, type-safe string formatting as a modern alternative to printf and iostreams.

title: Coroutine Basic (C++20)
explanation: Coroutines (C++20) allow functions to suspend and resume. co_yield returns a value and suspends execution.

title: Source Location (C++20)
explanation: source_location captures file name, line number, function name, and column — a type-safe alternative to __LINE__/__FILE__ macros.

title: Std Bit Operations (C++20)
explanation: std::bit (C++20) provides portable bit counting, rotation, power-of-2, and endian detection utilities.

title: Std Spanstream (C++23)
explanation: spanstream provides stream operations over a fixed buffer span without dynamic memory allocation.

title: Std Expected (C++23)
description: Return a value or an error without exceptions (C++23)
explanation: expected holds either a value or an error, similar to Rust's Result type, without exception overhead.

title: String Split By Delimiter
description: Split a string by a delimiter into tokens
explanation: String splitting is a common pattern. getline-based split is simplest; string_view split avoids allocations.

title: Lambda Overloaded Pattern
description: Compose multiple lambdas into one overloaded functor (C++17)
explanation: The overloaded pattern inherits multiple lambdas' operator()s, enabling type-specific dispatch in std::visit.

title: Sieve Linear (O(n))
description: Linear sieve that also computes smallest prime factor (SPF)
explanation: Linear sieve computes primes and smallest prime factor in O(n), enabling fast factorization.
